description: This file is a controller class in a PHP web application, specifically for managing the admin homepage components within the Goteo project. It defines actions for listing, adding, rearranging, and removing homepage elements, and manages available modules and types for homepage sections.

classes.name: HomeSubController
classes.description: Controller class for managing the homepage elements in the admin panel of the Goteo platform. Handles listing, creating, rearranging, and removing homepage widgets.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Handles the display and submission of the homepage element list, adding new elements, and preparing data for the admin view.

methods.name: upAction
methods.description: Moves a homepage element up in order.

methods.name: downAction
methods.description: Moves a homepage element down in order.

methods.name: removeAction
methods.description: Removes a homepage element from the list.
